nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon Intelligence SS: product Search API.

badgeAmazonsChoice.description: Amazon's Choice logo: `Y`, `N` or leave blank

badgeBestSeller.description: Best Seller Logo: `Y`, `N` or leave blank

badgeNewRelease.description: New Release ID: `Y`, `N` or leave blank

dataSnapshotMonth.description: Product data snapshot year and month in `yyyyMM` format, or `nearly` representing the last 30 days of real-time data; maxLength 1000

dimensionType.description: Packaging size type, please see the description below for each site code

filterSubNode.description: Whether to filter subcategory nodes; only takes effect when nodeLabel or nodeIdPath has a value

fulfillment.description: Delivery method: `AMZ`, `FBA`, `FBM`, multiple values separated by English commas

keyword.description: Search keywords, it is recommended to use the target site language; maxLength 10240

matchType.description: Matching method: `1` phrase matching, `2` fuzzy matching, `3` precise matching

maxAmzUnit.description: The highest sub-body sales volume in the past 30 days; only the query in the past 30 days is supported, the minimum value is 0

maxRatingsGrowthCount.description: Highest number of new ratings per month (>= 0)

maxUnitsGrowthRate.description: Maximum monthly sales growth rate, unit %

minAmzUnit.description: Minimum sub-body sales volume in the past 30 days; only `dataSnapshotMonth` is supported for queries in the past 30 days, the minimum value is 0

minRatingsGrowthCount.description: Minimum number of new ratings per month (>= 0)

minUnitsGrowthRate.description: Minimum monthly sales growth rate, unit %

order.description: Sorting configuration; it is recommended to provide both `field` and `desc` when passing in

field.description: Sorting fields: `total_units`, `total_amount`, `bsr_rank`, `price`, `rating`, `reviews`, `profit`, `reviews_rate`, `available_date`, `questions`, `total_units_growth`, `total_amount_growth`, `reviews_increasement`, `bsr_rank_cv`, `bsr_rank_cr`, `amz_unit`; passing an empty string means not to sort by the above business fields

sellerNation.description: Seller's location code, multiple values separated by commas

weightUnit.description: Weight unit: `g`, `kg`, `oz`, `lb`; must be specified when using weight filtering

name: nexscope_data_ss_product_search
title: Amazon Intelligence SS: product Search API
